entry.en: Your passport must be valid for at least 1 day after the day you plan to leave Costa Rica.
entry.es: El pasaporte debe ser válido al menos 1 día después del día en que planeas salir de Costa Rica.
entry.quote: Your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 1 day after the day you plan to leave Costa Rica.

entry.en: You need a yellow fever vaccination certificate if you come from a country listed as a transmission risk.
entry.es: Necesitas un certificado de vacunación contra la fiebre amarilla si llegas de un país considerado de riesgo de transmisión.
entry.quote: To enter Costa Rica, you must have a certificate to prove you’ve had a yellow fever vaccination if you’re coming from a country listed as a transmission risk.

entry.en: You must declare cash, travellers cheques or goods worth 10,000 US dollars or more.
entry.es: Debes declarar efectivo, cheques de viajero o bienes por valor de 10.000 dólares estadounidenses o más.
entry.quote: Declare cash, travellers cheques or goods if the value is 10,000 US dollars or more.

entry.en: When leaving by air you may need to pay a 29 US dollar departure tax, which most airlines include in the ticket price.
entry.es: Al salir por aire quizá debas pagar una tasa de salida de 29 dólares, que la mayoría de aerolíneas incluye en el billete.
entry.quote: When leaving the country by air, you may need to pay a departure tax of 29 US dollars. Most airlines include this in ticket prices.

entry.en: Entry requirements include having a return ticket.
entry.es: Entre los requisitos de entrada figura tener un billete de regreso.
entry.quote: The entry requirements include having a return ticket.

safety.en: Muggings and theft are significant problems, particularly on the Atlantic coast.
safety.es: Los asaltos y robos son problemas importantes, sobre todo en la costa atlántica.
safety.quote: Muggings and theft are significant problems, particularly on the Atlantic coast.

safety.en: Avoid leaving drinks unattended in bars, as there have been reports of spiked drinks resulting in assault and theft.
safety.es: No dejes bebidas sin vigilancia en los bares: se ha informado de bebidas adulteradas que derivaron en agresiones y robos.
safety.quote: Avoid leaving drinks unattended in bars as there have been reports of ‘spiked’ drinks resulting in assault and theft.

safety.en: There have been deaths and cases of serious illness caused by alcoholic drinks containing methanol in Costa Rica.
safety.es: Ha habido muertes y casos graves de enfermedad por bebidas alcohólicas con metanol en Costa Rica.
safety.quote: There have been deaths and cases of serious illness caused by alcoholic drinks containing methanol in Costa Rica.

safety.en: Rip currents are very common on Costa Rican beaches and there are often no lifeguards.
safety.es: Las corrientes de resaca son muy comunes en las playas de Costa Rica y a menudo no hay salvavidas.
safety.quote: While swimming on any beach in Costa Rica, bear in mind that rip currents are very common and there are often no lifeguards.

safety.en: Costa Rica has 16 volcanoes, several of which are considered active.
safety.es: Costa Rica tiene 16 volcanes, varios de ellos considerados activos.
safety.quote: Costa Rica has 16 volcanoes, several of which are considered active.

safety.en: Avoid unofficial taxis, known as taxi piratas.
safety.es: Evita los taxis no oficiales, conocidos como taxis piratas.

health.en: Medical care in Costa Rica is of a generally high standard, though ambulance services in remote areas may vary.
health.es: La atención médica en Costa Rica es en general de alto nivel, aunque las ambulancias en zonas remotas pueden variar.
health.quote: Medical care in Costa Rica is of a generally high standard. Ambulance services in remote areas may vary.

health.en: Visitors get only initial emergency treatment free of charge; later treatment is charged.
health.es: Los visitantes solo reciben gratis el tratamiento inicial de urgencia; el posterior se cobra.
health.quote: Only initial emergency medical treatment is available without charge for visitors. Subsequent treatment will be charged.

health.en: Call 911 and ask for an ambulance.
health.es: Llama al 911 y pide una ambulancia.
health.quote: Call 911 and ask for an ambulance.

health.en: Tap water in urban areas is almost always safe to drink.
health.es: El agua del grifo en zonas urbanas casi siempre es segura para beber.
health.quote: Tap water in urban areas of the country is almost always safe to drink.

health.en: Generally no vaccinations are needed to enter, but bring bug repellent against mosquitoes and diseases such as malaria.
health.es: En general no se exigen vacunas para entrar, pero lleva repelente contra mosquitos y enfermedades como la malaria.
health.quote: Generally, no vaccinations are needed to get into Costa Rica, but you should bring bug-repellent to keep away mosquitoes and other biting insects and prevent malaria and other similar diseases.

help.en: The emergency number for ambulance, fire and police is 911.
help.es: El número de emergencias para ambulancia, bomberos y policía es el 911.

getting_in.en: Juan Santamaría Airport (SJO) near Alajuela and San José is served by several airlines, including some European capitals.
getting_in.es: El aeropuerto Juan Santamaría (SJO), cerca de Alajuela y San José, tiene varias aerolíneas, incluidas algunas capitales europeas.
getting_in.quote: Juan Santamaría Airport (SJO IATA), close to the cities Alajuela (3 km (1.9 mi)), Heredia and the capital San José (25 km (16 mi)), is served by several airlines serving destinations in the Americas and some European capitals, and internal flights.

getting_in.en: Guanacaste Airport (LIR) near Liberia is closest to the Pacific Northwest coast.
getting_in.es: El aeropuerto de Guanacaste (LIR), cerca de Liberia, es el más cercano a la costa noroeste del Pacífico.
getting_in.quote: Guanacaste Airport (LIR IATA), near Liberia in the Guanacaste province, is closest to the Pacific Northwest coast.

getting_in.en: The northern border post with Nicaragua is Peñas Blancas and the southern one with Panama is Paso Canoas.
getting_in.es: El paso fronterizo del norte con Nicaragua es Peñas Blancas y el del sur con Panamá es Paso Canoas.
getting_in.quote: The border post in the north (to Nicaragua) is called Peñas Blancas and in the south (to Panamá) Paso Canoas (closes at 22:00 Costa Rican time, or 23:00 Panamá time).

getting_in.en: There is a US$29 exit fee for outbound international flights.
getting_in.es: Hay una tasa de salida de 29 dólares estadounidenses en los vuelos internacionales de salida.
getting_in.quote: There is a US$29 exit fee for outbound international flights.

getting_in.en: Bus services run from Panama, Nicaragua, Honduras, El Salvador, Mexico and Guatemala.
getting_in.es: Hay autobuses desde Panamá, Nicaragua, Honduras, El Salvador, México y Guatemala.
getting_in.quote: There are bus services from the neighboring countries of Panamá, Nicaragua, Honduras, El Salvador, Mexico and Guatemala.

getting_around.en: Public transport is cheap, with tickets rarely costing over US$7, and most towns are well served by buses.
getting_around.es: El transporte público es barato, con billetes que rara vez superan los 7 dólares, y la mayoría de pueblos tiene buen servicio de autobús.
getting_around.quote: Public transportation in Costa Rica is cheap (tickets rarely cost over US$7 each) and most towns are well served with buses.

getting_around.en: San José has no central bus station but several, each serving a different area of the country.
getting_around.es: San José no tiene una estación central de autobuses sino varias, cada una para una zona del país.
getting_around.quote: In San José there is no central bus station, but several different ones, each of which roughly serves a different area of the country, with some exceptions.

getting_around.en: Official taxis are red, or orange at the airport, with a triangular sticker and a roof box showing the company name and number.
getting_around.es: Los taxis oficiales son rojos, o naranjas en el aeropuerto, con una pegatina triangular y una caja en el techo con el nombre y número de la empresa.
getting_around.quote: Official taxis are red (or orange at the airport) with a triangular sticker and plastic box on the roof with the name and number of the taxi company.

getting_around.en: Private cars may enter San José only on certain weekdays, assigned by the last digit of the licence plate.
getting_around.es: Los coches particulares solo pueden entrar en San José ciertos días laborables, según el último dígito de la matrícula.
getting_around.quote: Private cars are only allowed to enter the capital of San José on certain weekdays, allocated using the last digit of the licence plate number.

getting_around.en: Waze is a favorite navigation app among Costa Ricans, with real-time traffic updates.
getting_around.es: Waze es una app de navegación favorita de los costarricenses, con actualizaciones de tráfico en tiempo real.
getting_around.quote: Waze, the smartphone application is a favorite among Costa Ricans as a GPS with real time updates on traffic.

getting_around.en: Train service is mostly a commuter layout around San José and is only rarely faster or cheaper than a bus.
getting_around.es: El tren funciona sobre todo como servicio de cercanías en San José y rara vez es más rápido o barato que el autobús.
getting_around.quote: Train service still suffers from decades of neglect and only rarely is a train faster or cheaper than a bus

money.en: The local currency is the Costa Rican colón (CRC).
money.es: La moneda local es el colón costarricense (CRC).
money.quote: The local currency is the Costa Rican colón (plural: colones) CRC named after Christopher Columbus (whose name was Cristobal Colón in Spanish)

money.en: US dollars are commonly used, and tourist establishments price almost everything in dollars, though prices are sometimes cheaper in colones.
money.es: Los dólares estadounidenses se usan mucho y los sitios turísticos ponen casi todo en dólares, aunque a veces es más barato en colones.
money.quote: U.S. dollars are commonly used; in tourist establishments, almost everything is priced in U.S. dollars (but sometimes prices are cheaper in colones).

money.en: It is very common to pay even small amounts by Visa or MasterCard, but much less common with American Express.
money.es: Es muy común pagar incluso importes pequeños con Visa o MasterCard, pero mucho menos con American Express.
money.quote: It is very common to pay even small amounts by Visa or MasterCard, but much less common with American Express.

money.en: ATMs are found in most places and normally dispense US dollars and colones.
money.es: Hay cajeros en la mayoría de sitios y normalmente dan dólares y colones.
money.quote: You can find ATMs in most places. They normally dispense U.S. dollars and colones.

money.en: Tipping is not customary in Costa Rica.
money.es: La propina no es costumbre en Costa Rica.
money.quote: Tipping is not customary in Costa Rica.

money.en: Costa Rica is very strict about accepting torn US dollar bills.
money.es: Costa Rica es muy estricta al aceptar billetes de dólar rotos.
money.quote: Be aware that Costa Rica is very strict with accepting torn US dollar bills.

etiquette.en: Being well-mannered (bien educado) is emphasised heavily in Costa Rica.
etiquette.es: En Costa Rica se da mucha importancia a ser bien educado.
etiquette.quote: Being bien educado (well-mannered) is emphasised heavily in Costa Rica.

etiquette.en: You are typically greeted with "buenos días" or "buenas" when entering shops, and it is polite to reply in kind.
etiquette.es: Al entrar en tiendas suelen saludarte con «buenos días» o «buenas», y es educado responder igual.
etiquette.quote: You will typically be greeted with “buenos días”, “buenas” or other iterations upon entering stores and other establishments, and it is polite to reciprocate this gesture.

etiquette.en: Outside tourist areas, dress like the locals so as not to stand out.
etiquette.es: Fuera de las zonas turísticas, viste como los locales para no destacar.
etiquette.quote: Outside tourist areas, and particularly in the main cities, dress like the locals in order to not stand out.

etiquette.en: Costa Ricans have a relaxed sense of time compared to North Americans and Europeans.
etiquette.es: Los costarricenses tienen un sentido del tiempo relajado en comparación con norteamericanos y europeos.
etiquette.quote: As in other Latin American countries, Costa Ricans have a relaxed sense of time compared to North Americans and Europeans.

etiquette.en: Smoking is banned in all businesses, public buildings, public transport and outdoor recreational and educational places.
etiquette.es: Está prohibido fumar en comercios, edificios públicos, transporte público y espacios recreativos y educativos al aire libre.
etiquette.quote: In 2012, Costa Rica banned smoking in all businesses, public buildings, public transportation, and outdoor recreational and educational places, such as parks and outdoor sports arenas.

etiquette.en: Avoid littering, feeding wild animals and removing or damaging vegetation.
etiquette.es: Evita tirar basura, alimentar animales salvajes y arrancar o dañar la vegetación.
etiquette.quote: Avoid littering, refrain from feeding wild animals, and don’t remove or damage vegetation.

connectivity.en: The country calling code for Costa Rica is +506.
connectivity.es: El prefijo telefónico de Costa Rica es +506.
connectivity.quote: The international calling code/country code for Costa Rica is +506.

connectivity.en: Bring an unlocked multi-band phone and buy a SIM card, which can be bought on almost any corner.
connectivity.es: Lleva un móvil desbloqueado multibanda y compra una SIM, que se vende en casi cualquier esquina.
connectivity.quote: Bring an unlocked quad or multi band cell phone that works on the proper frequencies and get a SIM card, which can be bought on almost any corner.

connectivity.en: On a short visit a prepaid plan (prepago) is the best option.
connectivity.es: En una visita corta lo mejor es un plan de prepago.
connectivity.quote: on a short visit your best chance is to get a pre-paid plan, or prepago which is contract-free and you pay in advance what you will use.

connectivity.en: An eSIM only needs an app download but is more expensive than a local SIM card.
connectivity.es: Una eSIM solo requiere descargar una app, pero es más cara que una SIM local.
connectivity.quote: To setup an esim you only need to download the app, you don't need a physical sim card. However, they are more expensive than local sim cards.

connectivity.en: Most tourist areas such as hotels, coffee shops, bars and restaurants have free Wi-Fi.
connectivity.es: La mayoría de zonas turísticas, como hoteles, cafeterías, bares y restaurantes, tiene wifi gratis.
connectivity.quote: Most tourist areas (hotels, coffee shops, bars, restaurants) have free Wi-fi access.
